Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Sir HN Reliance Foundation Hospital and Research Centre here today.
Located in the heart of south Mumbai, the hospital in its 90th year was re-built by Reliance Foundation, led by its chairperson Nita Ambani, into a modern 19-storey tower with two heritage wings,
